caption:
From 'doing fine' to 'nearly gone': where 5 Indian animals stand on the IUCN Red List.

IUCN's 2022 tiger reassessment put the global wild population at roughly 3,726–5,578, which makes India home to most of the world's wild tigers.

Source: IUCN Red List; Smithsonian's National Zoo; NTCA/WII Status of Tigers 2022. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
